description: This file is a shell script designed to test the application of git submodule changes through diff and apply commands. It defines functions to perform specific git operations involving submodules and executes test functions.

methods.name: apply_index
methods.description: Applies a diff ignoring submodule changes with --index, using the provided test result handler.

methods.name: apply_3way
methods.description: Applies a diff with --3way, ignoring submodule changes, using the provided test result handler.
